name: Shapr3D Educational License
benefit: One-year free Shapr3D educational 3D modeling license with advanced design features normally included in paid subscriptions.
eligibility: Active students, teachers or faculty at accredited educational institutions in supported countries, with a valid school email, school ID and current supporting proof.
duration: One year per approved grant; renewable while education status and regional eligibility remain valid.
restrictions: Strictly non-commercial educational use; only available in select countries. Team collaboration and priority technical support are excluded. If a paid trial is already running, cancel it before applying for EDU access.
